name: Market Claim Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of market claim in the context of a corporate action distribution event.

MKTC.name: Market Claim
MKTC.definition: Market claim that has been created due to a pending/failing settlement transaction, to ensure the event proceeds are delivered from the seller to the buyer.

RVMC.name: Reverse Market Claim
RVMC.definition: Market claim that has been created due to a settled settlement transaction, to ensure the event proceeds are delivered from the buyer to the seller.
